title: Pager-Path Determinism Fix / Scale-Zero Short-Circuit

root_cause.observe_only_perturbation: The build_ffn() observe-only hook was entered whenever g_prt_pager_enabled && g_prt_pager, even with no --prt-sidecar-apply and no --prt-sidecar-true-injection. This caused: (1) g_prt_pager_hook_calls++ mutation, (2) forensic log writes, (3) pager state machine calls with counter mutations, (4) decode-once cache access. Fix: add guard requiring g_prt_sidecar_apply_enabled || g_prt_sidecar_true_injection_enabled before hook body.
root_cause.scale_zero_perturbation: When --prt-sidecar-scale 0.0 was passed, the injection functions still called mmap, memcpy, ggml_mul_mat, and ggml_add to create a zero-tensor injection graph path. Even with scale=0, this could cause graph state differences from baseline. Fix: return native_out directly before any GGML ops when scale_env == 0.0f.

fixes_applied.change: Added guard condition: (g_prt_sidecar_apply_enabled || g_prt_sidecar_true_injection_enabled) was missing from the hook entry check
fixes_applied.effect: observe-only mode (--enable-prt-sidecar-pager only) now completely skips hook body — no counter mutations, no forensic writes, no cache state changes

fixes_applied.change: Added scale=0 short-circuit: if (g_prt_sidecar_scale_env == 0.0f) { munmap(buffer); return native_out; }
fixes_applied.effect: No ggml_mul_mat or ggml_add graph nodes when scale=0
